title: BuilderWars Help
intro: Everything you need for **BuilderWars**, {t:2026-11-14T10:00:00-05:00|D} – {t:2026-11-15T15:00:00-05:00|D} at Newlab Detroit. Pick a topic below.
unverifiedNotice: **You're not verified yet.** Registered on the website? Press **✅ Verify** to link your Discord account. Haven't registered? Sign up at {registrationUrl} first.

verify.label: Verify
verify.title: Verify your registration
verify.body:
Registration happens on the website, not in Discord.

1. Register at {registrationUrl} using your **current Discord username**.
2. Run `/verify` here and enter the email you registered with.
3. You'll get the **Participant** role, which unlocks workshops, teams and mentor help.

Changed your username, or verification isn't working? Ask an organizer. They can link your account for you.

workshops.label: Workshops
workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.body:
Run `/workshops` to see upcoming workshops, register, or join a waitlist when one is full. You'll get a reminder DM before each workshop you sign up for.

*Requires verification.*

teams.label: Teams
teams.title: Teams
teams.body:
Teams have **1 to 4 members**.

- `/team`: create a team, view yours, or leave
- `/find-team`: browse teams with open spots and request to join

No team yet? Come to Team Matchmaking at {t:2026-11-14T12:00:00-05:00|t} on Saturday.

*Requires verification.*

resources.label: Resources
resources.title: Resources
resources.body: Docs, tools and guides for building your project. Pick a category.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Pick a question to see the answer.

mentor.label: Get Mentor Help
mentor.title: Get mentor help
mentor.body:
Stuck? Run `/mentor`, pick a category, and describe the problem. A mentor will claim your request, and you'll get a DM when they're on the way.

*Requires verification.*

submission.label: Submission
submission.title: Submitting your project
submission.body:
Submit on [Shipyard](https://shipyardhq.tech/) by **{t:2026-11-15T12:00:00-05:00|F}**. Late submissions can't be accepted.

To be eligible for judging:
- Every team member checks in at the venue
- Your project is fully uploaded to Shipyard
- A demo video (5 minutes max) is linked in Shipyard **and** your GitHub repo
- Any AI tools you used are listed in your submission

Use `/submission` to share your team's links with the organizers.
